goals.title: Your Weekly Goals
goals.subtitle: Focus on 3 tiny habits
goals.why_three_text: Research shows: Less is more! Our brain can only process a limited number of new behaviors at once. With 1-3 habits you have the best chance of real, lasting success. Quality over quantity!
goals.hint_wenn_dann: Link your habit to a trigger - this triples success!
goals.hint_simple: Simply describe what you want to do - short and sweet!
goals.when_placeholder: e.g. I wake up in the morning
goals.then_placeholder: e.g. drink a glass of water
goals.ideas_subtitle: Tap to apply or get inspired
goals.reminder_text:
• Make your habits SO tiny that you cannot fail
• 1 pushup is better than 0
• Be kind to yourself!
goals.not_finished_message: Please fill in all 3 habits. Remember: They can be tiny!
goals.saved_message: Your weekly goals are saved. You took the first step - that's great!
goals.theory_intro: "If-Then Plans" (Implementation Intentions) are a scientifically researched method by Prof. Peter Gollwitzer. They help us turn resolutions into automatic behaviors.
goals.theory_example: "When I wake up in the morning, then I drink a glass of water"
goals.theory_why_text: Studies show: People with If-Then plans achieve their goals
goals.theory_why_text2: than people who only have general resolutions.
goals.theory_tips:
• Choose a specific trigger (time, place, action)
• Keep the habit tiny
• Formulate it in your own words
• Link it to existing routines
